scripts.build: npm run build -w @ckvf/core && npm run build -w @ckvf/browser && npm run build -w @ckvf/node && npm run build -w @ckvf/conformance
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/dist/core.test.js packages/node/dist/node.test.js packages/browser/dist/browser.test.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ckvf/core --if-present && npm run lint -w @ckvf/node --if-present && npm run lint -w @ckvf/browser --if-present
scripts.conformance: npm run build && npm run test -w @ckvf/conformance
